name: occlusion_reveal
description: Late-reveal crosser: a static wall of obstacles hugs the corridor at x=8..9 (y>0.8) and a fast pedestrian bursts from BEHIND it across the path, timed to the drone's arrival. Under GT-see-through perception the drone tracks the crosser through the wall (easy); under a future occluding front-end the track only starts at reveal -> the fresh-track/age-0 stressor. Kept in the library now so the same scenario becomes the acceptance test when realistic perception lands.
